meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 装了这个技能，Claude 会调用日历和任务工具，读取你指定日期的日程与未完成任务，生成带会议、待办、冲突提醒和空闲时段的摘要。
howto.when: 当你问“今天有什么安排”、“明天有什么会”等，或要求生成早报/standup report 时触发。

say.note: 会生成今天的日程与未完成任务摘要。
生成明日日程和到期待办清单。
汇总本周日程与未完成任务。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude reads your calendar events and incomplete tasks for a given date, then produces a summary with a schedule table, a to-do list, conflict alerts, and free time slots.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about your schedule and to-dos, e.g. 'What's on today?', 'What meetings tomorrow?', or 'What's left this week?', or when you request a morning/standup report.

say_en.note: Generates today's schedule and task summary.

say_en.text: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
say_en.note: Creates tomorrow's schedule and due to-dos.

say_en.text: What else is on this week?
say_en.note: Summarizes this week's calendar and tasks.
